native_frame_convention: Frame-order samples before display transforms; little-endian multi-byte samples, stored signed representation unchanged, manifest planar organization, one-bit native frames packed continuously without per-frame padding, and no container bytes.

transfer_syntaxes.name: RLE Lossless
transfer_syntaxes.external_decoder: DCMTK 3.7.0 dcmdrle plus dcmdump raw Pixel Data extraction
transfer_syntaxes.supported_shapes: 8/16-bit monochrome and RGB cases in the current corpus

transfer_syntaxes.name: Native and deflated datasets
transfer_syntaxes.external_decoder: case-scoped uv-locked pydicom raw U32 extractor; DCMTK 3.7.0 dcm2img plus dcmdump for Multi-frame Single Bit SC, linked RT Image, and Phase 4 single-frame VL RGB
transfer_syntaxes.independence: independent for the explicitly supported U32, U1, linked RT Image, and Phase 4 VL RGB shapes; unresolved otherwise
transfer_syntaxes.supported_shapes: classic/sc/mono2_u32_explicit_le, classic/sc/mono2_u1_native, non-image/rt/image_linked, vl/endoscopic/rgb_explicit_le, and vl/microscopic/rgb_explicit_le only
transfer_syntaxes.status: partially implemented: every other native pixel shape remains an explicit unsupported result
